entries.reason: a departure from 12.0, whose -generateTokenWithCompletionHandler: asks the daemon com.apple.devicecheckd, which iOS 6 does not run
entries.effect: the handler hears DCErrorFeatureUnsupported from the DeviceCheck domain with no user info, on a background queue after the call has returned; the release itself, when it cannot reach its daemon, answers DCErrorUnknownSystemFailure
entries.source: DeviceCheck of iOS 12.0 arm64: -[DCDevice isSupported] at 0x19e6794f8, +[DCDevice currentDevice] at 0x19e679170 and -[DCDevice generateTokenWithCompletionHandler:] at 0x19e6791f0; the host's DeviceCheck through Mac Catalyst
